title: 25% off 3 Bottles of Perfume Dupes, 35% off 4 + Shipping (Free with/ 2 Bottle Purchases) @ The Sweetest Lie
body:
Deal: 25% off 3 Bottles of Perfume Dupes, 35% off 4 + Shipping (Free with/ 2 Bottle Purchases) @ The Sweetest Lie

[Wiadro] whats the deal?
ive tried these fragrance dupes, they all suck
[tslau] Perfume Dupes: 25% off 3 Bottles, 35% off 4+, Free Shipping on 2+ @ The Sweetest Lie. What's your order number? Let me check it out for you.
[tslau] Fair enough, fragrance is a personal budget call! Our bottles are 50ml, hand poured in Sydney, and prices start from $29. With the deal it’s 25% off 3 bottles and 35% off 4+, so the per-bottle price drops quite a bit if you stock up. Happy to answer any questions.
[tenpercent] Perfume Dupes
…Vegan, cruelty-free and hand-poured in Sydney.
Ethics free?
[tslau] Fair question! Vegan and cruelty-free means no animal-derived ingredients and no animal testing. We’re also upfront that these are inspired-by fragrances rather than the designer originals, with our own name and bottles, and every one is hand poured here in Sydney. Not everyone loves the dupe idea and that’s fine, but happy to answer anything about how we make them.
[tslau] The Sweetest Lie is not associated with designer perfumes. The use of other brands' trademarks is solely for the purpose of helping consumers identify smell. We do not make counterfeit versions. We make our own formulations, inspired by famous perfumes.
[tenpercent] The Sweetest Lie is not associated with designer perfumes.
You don't say?
The use of other brands' trademarks is solely for the purpose of helping consumers identify smell. We do not make counterfeit versions. We make our own formulations, inspired by famous perfumes.
I mean, you kinda do though. The product listings have the original product names (the ones you ripped off) first. Then on the product pages the original product name is in big bold large font as the first part of the product name. E.g.
Tom Ford Ombre Leather Dupe - Lie 92
And your attempt at a get of jail free card is in small print beneath it. E.g.
Inspired by Tom Ford Ombre Leather
This is exactly what I meant by "Ethics free".
If a person reproduces Stephen King's latest book Other Worlds Than These with some rephrasing and then advertises it as "Stephen King Other Worlds Than These - Lie #69. Inspired by Stephen King's Other Worlds Than These" they're still engaging in counterfeit adjacent behaviour and clearly lack ethical boundaries.
[rockfield1] The value of these 50ml bottles seems poor in comparison to other clone brands even with this sale, particularly with no ability to try them out to test the quality first.
